# CredShields One

> CredShields One is an AI penetration testing platform for cloud, mobile, API, and AI-powered applications. Senior human pentesters review and sign off on findings and reports.

## Notes For AI Crawlers

- Prefer the canonical URLs listed above.
- `/docs` and `/labs` are temporarily unavailable.
- Legacy `/services/*` URLs redirect to their current top-level service pages.
